source.terms: Criteo official terms apply CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and limit licensed use to noncommercial purposes with attribution and share-alike conditions.

dataset.samplingRule: first 60000 physical rows from the pinned day=2015-02-15 part-00079 parquet shard; no label-conditioned sampling

split.semantics: fixed contiguous source-order blocks; not described as chronological because parquet conversion order was not independently audited

training.selection: minimum dev LogLoss checkpoint only; test never selects epochs or hyperparameters

deepfm.initialization: zero first-order embeddings and Normal(0,0.01) factor embeddings

implementationAudit.reason: Default unit-scale categorical factor embeddings caused 39-field FM initial logits and train/dev LogLoss to explode; corrected from train/dev evidence before the final run.

limitations: This is a fixed 60000-row prefix of one official parquet shard, not the full 1TB or 24-day dataset.
The shard belongs to one published day, but the Hugging Face parquet conversion order was not independently audited; the split is source-order, not claimed temporal.
Criteo states positive and negative examples were subsampled at different rates, so raw probabilities are not population CTR without correction.
Hashed categorical feature semantics are undisclosed.
Offline public-data metrics do not establish KAI production, online lift, or business performance.
CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 restricts this dataset use to noncommercial purposes under its terms.
